title: docs: Vercel deployment URLs and 401 / Deployment Protection
body: ## Summary The deployment URL `https://ledgernew-3jcrmy9hg-cajub311s-projects.vercel.app/` fails for visitors because **Vercel Deployment Protection** returns **401** for unauthenticated requests to that hostname (including `/_expo/static/...` JS). The app shell can load while bundles do not, so the UI stays on the loading spinner. **Working public URL:** `https://ledgernew.vercel.app` (production alias) — HTML and JS return **200** without auth. ## Change - README: document why preview deployment URLs can appear broken, how to verify with `curl`, and point to **Deployment Protection** settings or production aliases. No application code changes.
